Aussie Broadband questions

What is the cheapest Aussie Broadband NBN plan?

Basic Plus NBN 25/10 at $58/mo for 6 months, then $83/mo. That is $846 over the first year (checked 8 October 2026).

Does Aussie Broadband let you opt out of CGNAT?

Yes, Aussie Broadband gives customers a public IP address free on request.

Do you need to give Aussie Broadband 30 days notice to cancel?

No. Aussie Broadband doesn't require a 30-day notice period to cancel.

Which mobile network does Aussie Broadband use?

Aussie Broadband runs on the Optus Network, which covers about 98.5% of Australians.

Has Aussie Broadband raised its prices recently?

Yes. The most recent ongoing price rise we recorded was 45GB 45GB on 12 August 2026, from $40 to $50.
